newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy parlt budget debate set for Oct 30-Nov 14.
newsitem.headline: Italy parlt budget debate set for Oct 30-Nov 14.

text.p: Italy's draft 1997 budget will be submitted to the full Chamber of Deputies (lower house) on October 30 with a final vote due by November 14, officials said on Wednesday.

They said the timetable had been agreed by a meeting of parliamentary party leaders. The budget aims to cut next year's deficit by 62.5 trillion lire ($42 billion) and has been working its way through lower house commissions.
The officials said that, under the timetable, general debate on the budget and associated legislation would take place on October 30 and 31.
Voting on proposed amendments would begin on November 4, with parliament also sitting on Saturdays and Sundays, with the aim of a final vote by November 14.

Once it has been approved by the lower house, the budget must pass to the Senate (upper house) for passage. The deadline for full approval is December 31, although the centre-left government is hoping for speedy passage.
The government relies for support in the lower house on the hard left party Communist Refoundation, but has a majority in its own right in the Senate.
